highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: VU#874418: RDK-B WebUI contains multiple vulnerabilities and Medusa ransomware group attacked more than 500 victims since 2021. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Hackers compromise 14,500 Dahua web cameras in 35-day campaign. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Rogue ransomware affiliate poses as recovery firm to steal payments. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
